description: Bank security alert about a sign-in from an unrecognised device. Highest-signal category.

messages.raw:
From: Example Bank Security <security-alerts@bank.example>
To: demo@local.test
Subject: Alert: new sign-in to your account from an unrecognised device
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 22:41:00 +0000
Message-ID: <sec-4471@bank.example>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"

We detected a new sign-in to your account.

Details of the activity:
  When: 28 September 2026 at 22:38
  Where: an IP address in a location we do not normally see from you
  Device: Chrome on Windows

If this was you, no action is required and you can ignore this message.

If you do not recognise this sign-in, your password may have been compromised.
Please secure your account immediately by resetting your password and reviewing
your active sessions. If you do not reset your password within 24 hours, we will
temporarily lock your account to protect it from unauthorised access, and you
will need to contact the branch to restore access.

Never share your password with anyone, including someone claiming to be from the
bank.

Example Bank Security Team
